spells/sandblast-1563.name: Sandblast
spells/sandblast-1563.effectSummary: Fires an instantaneous 60-foot cone of sand and hurricane-force wind. Every creature and object in the cone takes 6d8 damage. A creature that fails the spell's Fortitude save also suffers the hurricane wind result for its size: Medium or smaller is blown away, Large is knocked down, Huge is checked, and Gargantuan or Colossal is unaffected by the forced movement. For this spell, the spell's own Fortitude save controls both damage and wind: a successful save halves the 6d8 damage and ignores the wind effect. A checked ground creature cannot move forward against the wind; a checked flying creature is blown back 1d6×5 feet. A knocked-down ground creature falls prone; a flying creature is instead blown back 1d6×10 feet. A blown-away ground creature is knocked prone and rolled 1d4×10 feet, taking 1d4 nonlethal damage per 10 feet; a flying creature is blown back 2d6×10 feet and takes 2d6 nonlethal damage. The material component is a handful of sand from the heart of a desert.
spells/sandblast-1563.notes: Source-locked to the Lost Empires of Faerûn 6th-level Sandblast, which is a distinct spell from the lower-level Complete Divine/Spell Compendium spell of the same name. The ordinary DMG hurricane DC 20 is shown for reference; Sandblast explicitly uses its own spell saving throw for this instantaneous effect.

spells/winds-favor-4860.name: Wind's Favor
spells/winds-favor-4860.effectSummary: Creates a 10-foot-wide, 10-foot-high corridor of strong wind extending 100 feet + 10 feet per caster level for 1 hour per level. The wind is approximately 30 mph. Strong wind automatically extinguishes unprotected flames, imposes a -2 penalty on normal ranged attacks and Listen checks, and knocks down Tiny or smaller creatures that fail the ordinary DC 10 wind save; Small or larger ground creatures are not displaced. Flying or airborne creatures count as one size category smaller for wind effects. By concentrating as a full-round action, you can rotate the wind's direction by 45 degrees. The spell duplicates the lesser Mark of Storm wind's favor ability except that this spell uses the range and area printed in its own header.

spells/snakebite-1792.name: Snakebite
spells/snakebite-1792.effectSummary: For 1 round per level, one arm becomes a venomous snake. Its bite deals 1d3 damage and delivers poison dealing 1d6 Constitution damage as both initial and secondary damage; each Constitution-damage instance is negated by a Fortitude save with DC 10 + half your caster level + your Wisdom modifier. If the victim fails either poison save, it must also make a Will save against the spell's normal save DC or be paralyzed for 1d4 rounds. The transformed hand cannot hold a weapon, but the other hand can wield a weapon or supply somatic components. If you attack with the snake arm and a weapon, use the Player's Handbook 3.0 two-weapon penalties in the restored table. Only one snakebite spell can affect you at a time.
